contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could be done and it was decided beforehand, yet describes an analysis with fixable findings delivered three weeks late, after the test ended.
Rep says the uplift number got silence, but Stefan responded explicitly with 'that's an average' and 'I can't take an average to my CFO'.
Rep says 'we weren't really pitching' but then describes presenting the Authorization Boost deck and Adaptive Acceptance.
Rep calls the account healthy with nothing on anybody's list, but there was no business review for 9-10 months and the new head of payments went unnoticed.
Rep says nobody wanted to rip anything out and the customer likes the product, yet the customer asked to split the contract and moved business to local acquiring.

The CFO decision went up about two weeks before the last call, while our analysis arrived three weeks after Stefan asked. The decision may have preceded delivery, so the timeline does not fully line up.
Stefan called our analysis the most useful thing we'd sent, but also said he only heard from Stripe when he said he was leaving.

dodges.question: When did you first feel this was lost? What happened right before?
dodges.what: Rep answered 'no moment' and 'nothing to do', then described a delayed analysis, a missing named contact, and fixable findings.

dodges.what: Rep could not say what the Adyen test showed; the customer would not share it.
